info.scriptSrcText: property MaxToggle, thisglobal gShockwave_ResolutionObj, gShockwave_ExitObjon beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  MaxToggle = 0  this.loc = point(0, the stageBottom - the stageTop)  if voidp(gShockwave_ResolutionObj) then    if (the environment).runMode <> "Author" then      this.locV = -1000    end if  end if  put "No Xtra found"endon mouseLeave  this.flipH = 0  this.flipV = 0  this.blend = 100endon mouseWithin  this.flipH = 0  this.flipV = 0  this.blend = 100  if the mouseH <= 11 then    if the mouseDown then      this.blend = 70    end if    this.flipH = 1    this.flipH = 1  end ifendon mouseUp  if the mouseH <= 11 then    if objectp(gShockwave_ResolutionObj) then      gShockwave_ExitObj.mExit()    end if    put "CallClose"  end ifend
